_comment: Product constants read by universal agents. Copy to <repo>/.claude/product-spec.json, replace every <placeholder>, keep the key names exactly as-is. _comment* keys are documentation and may be deleted once filled.
_comment_domain: Production domain - canonical URLs, health checks, sitemap base.

repo._comment: primaryRemote is where pushes go; mirror (or null) is auto-mirrored; a push to deployBranch on primaryRemote IS a production deploy; pushPolicy 'propose-and-wait' = never push without explicit approval, 'auto' = an opted-in loop may push itself.

_comment_deployGate: The single command that must pass before any push (format + typecheck + lint + build + audits).
_comment_stackPack: Which shared rule pack in ~/.claude/rule-packs/ applies to this repo.

db._comment: envVar names the connection-string env var; dialect drives SQL quirks (quoting, casts, adapters).

budgets._comment: Per-route performance budgets plus the external-API cost ceiling. Numbers, not strings. Any single external call estimated above maxSingleApiCallUsd requires explicit owner approval.

observability._comment: sentry true/false - whether Sentry is wired, so reviewers know to tag errors and check post-deploy health.

_comment_testDataConvention: Greppable pattern ALL seeded test records must follow so cleanup never touches real data.
_comment_dashboards: URLs the owner watches - where status and blockers surface.
_comment_locales: Supported locales; first entry is the default.
